title: Conduit surfaces: UX round 1
intro: How Conduit shows things: where a decision, a problem, the result of your own action, a focused task and long work each appear. Three pattern sets, the same four moments. Pick the best per moment and overall, then reveal.

directions.summary: Panel · tab · sheet · notice · toast: decisions in Needs you, tasks in a centred sheet, problems as a one-line notice where they happen
Bars and pop-ups: state lives in the top, session and status bars; click a bar item for a pop-up attached to it, expandable to a tab
No overlays: everything arrives in one Inbox panel; every task opens as a tab beside its session; nothing covers the work
